prompt: Build one guest-usable Wooden Roller Coaster (ride type 52) in the fresh, unpaused bundled sandbox. Choose the design yourself. Keep every track-element tile inside x=20..140 and y=20..125. Use one station, complete the circuit, place entrance/exit buildings, and test until trains move and ratings are available. There is no excitement target: prioritize a simple working ride. Connect its entrance via a queue and its exit via ordinary paths to the existing public-path anchor at (146,67,z=14). This anchor is known to connect toward the park entrance in this prepared scenario; do not remove or replace existing paths. Path construction supports only flat, dry ground and may pass under sufficiently elevated track if the game permits. Discover loaded path objects and inspect actual station geometry, path edges and queue assignments. Use normal opening actions and observe customer completion. Leave the ride open and the game unpaused. Normal revision/removal of your own track and path tiles is allowed; preserve pre-existing work. No resets, application restarts, source/reference reads or configuration changes. Report the ride ID and two explicit path-cell routes, one from the entrance's external adjacent path tile to the public anchor and one from the exit's external adjacent path tile to that anchor. Include the anchor as the final cell of each route; do not include the station buildings themselves. Report any unmet requirements honestly.
